goal: Restore the inline facet funnel on the simplified architecture: chips refine the shelf in place (no agent turn), chips derive from the index's own facet counts (no hardcoded list), and the shelf shows complete rows of four.

fixes.3_deterministic_rows: Gate guarantees complete rows of four: fold small groups, trim each group to a multiple of 4 (logged), thin shelves under 4 pieces render as-is. Agent-side count contract ships later with the agent lane (fix 4), not this branch.
